text:
chen: Quick question — we're seeing spike of bad reranks from the new model variant. I'm about to flip the model-level flag `model.safe_rerank` off across org to force fallbacks. Who is allowed to do org-wide disables during incidents, and what's the handback process so we don't lose owner context?

alex: In practice SRE/eng-platform on-call can do org-level disables for incidents. Ops needs to annotate reason + expiry. After stabilization, the model owners should be re-granted ownership to decide next steps.

sam: Tooling note: use `flagctl` (requires 2FA) or the Console -> Flags -> Emergency toggle. Prefer CLI for audit metadata.

chen: example CLI I'm about to run so y'all can review:```bash
flagctl update model.safe_rerank --scope org --value off --reason "prod rerank hallucinations" --expires 60m --meta "incident=INC-1967"
```

maria: +1 to CLI. Add `--owner-handback alex,priya` in the meta so handback is explicit. Also add the audit ticket ID. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: runbook note — step 1: org disable ok for Priority 1 incidents if SRE lead approves. Remember to create an ops ticket and set expiry.

deploy-bot: Applied org override `model.safe_rerank=off` by chen. Audit ID: A-196700-01. Expires in 60m.

alex: Two practical points: 1) Our inheritance rules mean route-level or project-level explicit allows can still re-enable for a narrow route unless you use the emergency force mode. 2) For an absolute stop, use `--force-global` (only ops role).

priya: Can you confirm the precedence for the team? It's easy to get confused during an incident.

sam: Quick reference we use: most specific wins — route > model > project > org. So org is the widest scope and is overridden by more specific scopes unless `--force-global` is used.

chen: OK that matches what I thought. For this incident I want the org-level off and also to block route-level overrides. I'll ask SRE lead for force.

maria: After deploy-bot audit, please open INC ticket and add handback checklist: create a PR with flag change history, tests showing regressions fixed, and a proposed rollout plan for the model team.

alex: I'll take the handback PR once you file it. We'll verify canary for two routes, then remove the org override.

priya: I'll run the focused evals on the canary routes and post results here.

chen: Action items: 1) I run the CLI disable now (done). 2) @alex to review handback PR. 3) @priya to run evals. 4) ops to confirm force-global was used (if so we'll note it in the ticket).

maria: Also add `audit: A-196700-01` to the handback PR and link the runbook section so reviewers know it's emergency revert flow.

alex: Thanks all — ping me when PR is up.

priya: Will post results in ~30m.

chen: Closing loop — I've filed INC-1967 and linked audit A-196700-01 in the ticket. Marking thread for follow-up.
